title: Design: New Customer shows Bill Invoices To between Credit Limit and Sales Rep
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Start on the Customers page.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p1-02-after-bill-invoices-to-empty.png, bt-p1-01-before-new-customer.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Customer.
  2. Resize the browser window to 1536 pixels wide.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A full-width field labelled "Bill Invoices To" sits directly under the Credit Terms | Credit Limit row and directly above Sales Representative, as in the picture.
  • It reads "This customer" and has a down arrow at its right, like the other dropdown fields.
  • No help line shows under it.
  • Address 1 has a + at its right and there is no Address 2 field.

Step 2:

  • The field order is unchanged and nothing in the window wraps, overlaps or is cut off.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12304 (Story 2, Bill Invoices To in New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S2-R1: “New Customer and Edit Customer show a searchable "Bill Invoices To" field, reading "This customer" until another customer is picked.”
  • S2-R2: “The field sits after Credit Terms | Credit Limit and before Sales Representative (context: field order shared with SV-11638 and SV-10890).”
  • S2-N2: “New Customer shows no help line under the field.”
  • S2-R6: “An empty Address 2 is hidden; a + button beside Address 1 (tooltip "Add Address 2") shows it.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "1 Set a customer's default Bill To", pictures "Bill Invoices To, empty" (This build), "New Customer" (Production (v26.45.2.1)).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p1-02-after-bill-invoices-to-empty.png
  • bt-p1-01-before-new-customer.png

The design's own words:

  • “"Bill Invoices To" sits after Credit Terms and Credit Limit and before Sales Representative. It reads "This customer".”
  • “No help line under it in New Customer.”

The attached production picture shows no red error toast although its design note mentions one; compare only the window's fields.
